headline: Titagarh Rail Systems Secures ₹77 Crore Wagon Contract From JSW
summary: Indian rolling stock manufacturer Titagarh Rail Systems won a ₹77.09 crore order from JSW Rail Logistics to supply 184 specialized railway wagons.
why: Titagarh Rail Systems is a major Indian manufacturer of passenger and freight railway rolling stock.
